_note: Kibale NP project takeoff rules. Schema verified against StingTools/BOQ/Takeoff/TakeoffRule.cs:46-63. PROJECT rules are PREPENDED over the corporate baseline and a corporate rule sharing an id is dropped (TakeoffRule.cs:311-329), so ordering here is priority. Reload with Cost_ReloadRules after editing. quantitySource accepts: literal:<n> | LocationCurve | SolidVolume | LookupParameter:<name> | any BuiltInParameter name. unitConversion accepts: ft2_to_m2 | ft3_to_m3 | ft_to_m | none.

rules.description: Swimming pool shell — reinforced concrete, formed and finished as detailed
rules.notes: Without this the pool falls through DeriveNrm2Section to the architectural default, NRM2 s23 'building fabric sundries'. Requires ASS_PRODCT_COD_TXT = POOL on the element.

rules.description: Site formation — bulk earthworks, cut and fill to formation level
rules.notes: STING_DEFAULT_COST_RATES.csv:115 prices Toposolid at 60 per m2 — AREA, not volume. This rule measures volume instead. It still does NOT read Revit's graded-region Cut/Fill properties (gap B-2), so treat the number as indicative and reconcile against the toposolid schedule before issue.

rules.description: Cement and sand screed, laid to falls where indicated, floated to receive floor finish
rules.notes: There is NO screed parameter and NO screed formula anywhere in STINGTOOLS (gap G-11). This rule is the only way screed reaches the bill. Requires the screed to be its own floor element with ASS_PRODCT_COD_TXT = SCR. Section 21 = Surface finishes.

rules.description: Floor finish, laid on prepared screed, including all trims and thresholds
rules.notes: Per-room finish floors (playbook Part 3A). 10 percent waste is the tile/parquet cutting allowance — set here because WasteTable's material key never reaches a priced quantity (gap E-4).

rules.description: Reinforced concrete slab, as designed, including formwork and finishing
rules.notes: Ordered before any generic Floors rule so the structural slab bills as concrete by volume, not as a surface finish by area.

rules.description: Makuti thatch roof covering on timber purlins, laid to falls, including ridging and eaves detail
rules.notes: 12 percent allowance reflects thatch lapping and dressing, which is materially higher than the sheet-roofing default.

rules.description: Reinforced concrete retaining wall, including formwork, drainage layer and weepholes
rules.notes: On 27.75 m of fall these are a major item and must not bill as ordinary blockwork walling by area.

rules.description: Hardcore filling, deposited, levelled and compacted in layers, blinded to receive slab
rules.notes: Hardcore exists as a waste keyword and two parameters but has no material row and no rate anywhere in the library (gap E-9). Add the material too — see the playbook, Part 4A.

rules.description: Timber skirting, fixed to wall, mitred at angles, sanded and finished
rules.notes: ONLY use this if you model skirting as a wall element. If you use a wall sweep instead — which is the better model — skirting cannot be taken off at all and must be a measured addition: there is no skirting LENGTH parameter anywhere in MR_PARAMETERS.txt (gap G-11).
